question: Does the decision change measured in Phase 9 translate into fuel, CO2 and money, and can every number be traced to a run and a sourced factor?

scopes.excl_S6: without S6_high_demand (fleet overload, unserved trips differ)

claim_rule: A saving is reported as a saving only if the paired day-bootstrap CI95 excludes 0; otherwise it is reported as no clear difference.

gates.G1_provenance: every factor has source_type and source/derivation; input metrics and config hashes recorded
gates.G2_independent_recompute: fuel, distance and site idle recomputed from raw logs match Phase 9 metrics for all runs (fuel/distance within 0.051 because kpi rounds to 0.1)
gates.G3_chain_closes: delta fuel = delta moving + delta idle and delta CO2 = delta fuel x factor for every comparison
gates.G4_placeholder_in_public_range: public reference values lie inside the simulated km/L and idle L/h ranges

unserved_policy: Unserved trips are not monetised (no sourced penalty). Report them next to every saving; fuel per delivered m3 is shown to control for them.
